sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static requirement. It preserves the universal hazard rule without imposing hazard existence, requires voyagePlanPresent = true when applicable, requires true voyage-plan coverage with no non-true coverage when a hazard exists, and makes the applicability alternatives mutually exclusive with exact boolean values. Targets, canonical namespace, datatypes, and owner structure are valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove sh:minCount 1 from nltl:intendedVoyageHazard unless an independent requirement explicitly mandates that at least one hazard value exists. The obligation is universal coverage of each intended hazard and does not itself imply hazard-register existence; retain the conditional voyage-plan and aggregate coverage checks.

The current coverage query passes whenever voyagePlanCoverage true exists, even if a non-true value also exists; when an intendedVoyageHazard exists, reject every non-true coverage value and separately require at least one true coverage value. Also make the applicability alternatives mutually exclusive by rejecting the opposite value in each branch (a node with both true and false currently satisfies either branch). Preserve the prior instruction not to add sh:minCount to intendedVoyageHazard; no vocabulary matcher is needed.

Repair the applicable branch to require nltl:polarCodeChapter11Dash1Applicable exactly true and reject any false value; repair the inapplicable branch to require exactly false and reject any true value, so contradictory multi-valued applicability cannot satisfy either alternative. In the applicable branch, retain voyagePlanPresent = true and ensure that when an intendedVoyageHazard exists, at least one nltl:voyagePlanCoverage true value exists and no non-true coverage value exists; the current query accidentally passes when true coverage is absent. Preserve the prior instruction to omit sh:minCount from nltl:intendedVoyageHazard. No vocabulary matcher is needed.

The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static requirement. It preserves the universal hazard rule without imposing hazard existence, requires voyagePlanPresent = true when applicable, requires true voyage-plan coverage with no non-true coverage when a hazard exists, and makes the applicability alternatives mutually exclusive with exact boolean values.
